full_judgment:
A.T.M. Afzal, J. :-This petition by the plaintiff is from the judgment and order dated 4 February 1988 passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division, Rangpur Bench in revision setting aside the judgment and decree passed by the District Judge, Rajshahi in Title Appeal No. 110 of 1984 and restoring those of the Munsif, Additional Court, Rajshahi in O.C. Suit No. 1 of 1984 (393/1983). 

 3. The suit was dismissed in the trial Court but decreed in appeal whereupon the defendants took a revision to the High Court Division against the appellate decree. As already noticed the High Court Division set aside the appellate decree and restored that of the trial Court by the impugned judgment and order.
